Method of Attack: Distributing fake Windows 11 upgrade installers containing RedLine stealer malware
Malware executed via decompressed executable launching PowerShell and cmd.exe processes
Fetching and loading a DLL payload arranged in reverse form to evade detection
DLL connects to command-and-control server via TCP for instructions
Impacted Systems: Windows 10 systems targeted for Windows 11 upgrade
Attack Vector: Fake upgrade website (windows-upgraded.com) distributing malicious ZIP archive
User downloading and executing fake installer from Discord CDN
Social engineering via fake Windows 11 upgrade prompts
Indicators of Compromise: Payload: RedLine stealer DLL fetched as .jpg file from remote server
Processes: PowerShell with encoded argument, cmd.exe with timeout
